key_insight: AIProver combines an evolving agentic harness with certificate-driven training to improve research-level theorem auto-formalization and proof synthesis beyond simple compilation.
engineering_relevance: It shows that robust formal math automation needs both model adaptation and harness adaptation, not just a bigger language model or a fixed tool pipeline.
method: Jointly post-trains a 119B open-weight model for natural-language to Lean formalization and proof synthesis.
Uses verifiers to check type correctness, proof completeness, and semantic correctness, producing diagnostic certificates.
Applies HarnessEvolve: evolutionary search over the agent/tool-control flow guided by certificate feedback.
evidence_signal: The paper introduces LoCoBench with 58.9k instances across multiple math sources and reports semantic correctness gains from 15.7% to 36.7% on the Leanstral-1.5 base, with stronger results when used as a skill in Claude Code and Codex.
watch_item: Semantic correctness still depends on benchmark coverage and verifier quality, so unseen concepts or weak certificates could limit real-world reliability.
paper_title: AIProver: Agentic Auto-Formalization of Mathematical Research via Certificate-Driven Evolving Harness
